    In the split Grothendieck group a finite direct power has the expected class.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_bongartz_at_projective_with_source {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (G : FGModuleCat R) [Module.Projective R ↑G] :
    ∃ (Q : TwoTerm R) (ι : G ⟶ CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential), (∀ (K : FGModuleCat R) (i : K ⟶ Q.source) (r : Q.source ⟶ K), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp i r = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id K → CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp i Q.differential = 0 → ∃ (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → (K ⟶ P.source)) (b : Fin m → (P.source ⟶ K)), (∀ (j : Fin m), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (a j) P.differential = 0) ∧ ∑ j : Fin m, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (a j) (b j) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id K) ∧ ((∀ (a : P.source ⟶ P.source), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a P.differential = P.differential → CategoryTheory.IsIso a) → ∀ (a : Q.source ⟶ Q.source), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a Q.differential = Q.differential → CategoryTheory.IsIso a) ∧ Q.projectiveClass = ProjectiveClass.of ⟨G, ⋯⟩ + Module.finrank k (P.source ⟶ G) • P.projectiveClass ∧ Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential)) ∧ (∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose M) → Function.Surjective ⇑(Q.precompose M)) ∧ ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose M) → ∀ (f : G ⟶ M), ∃ (g : CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential ⟶ M), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ι g = f

    The Bongartz construction starting from any projective gives a compatible complex of class [G] + n[P]. Every map from G to a module in the weak torsion class factors through the cokernel of this complex.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_bongartz_complement {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) :
    ∃ (Q : TwoTerm R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential)) ∧ (∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose M) → Function.Surjective ⇑(Q.precompose M)) ∧ ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose M) ↔ IsGeneratedBy (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential) M

    A Bongartz complement in two-term form. Its cokernel generates the weak torsion class, and its Hom differential is surjective into every object of that class.
